documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Amal Ltd reported consolidated and standalone sales growth of 77% and 74% to Rs 240 crore and Rs 85 crore respectively in FY2026, primarily driven by a 164% spike in raw material Sulphur prices. Consolidated PBT decreased by 14% to Rs 28 crore as increased input costs could not be fully passed through. Capital expenditure for Sulphur yard upgradation was completed during the year, and three additional projects are currently under implementation alongside evaluation of two growth projects. The company remains debt-free with a cash surplus of Rs 38 crore and recommended an increased dividend of 15% (Rs 1.5 per share). Amal Ltd reported consolidated revenue from operations of ` 13,532 lakh and profit before tax of ` 3,261 lakh for FY 2024-25.
